briefing:
Rolf: Follow twelve revealed flag cones across the countryside, then finish within 385 seconds.
Different serpentine route from FD-09, twelve sequential flag cones using the ML-4 reveal/knock mechanic. Flags are targets, not cone-hit faults. HUD guidance stands in for radio; restart-direction issues are not simulated.
The pad stands in for Auvergne; its Boxster stands in for the 1994 993 Carrera Coupé. Police, traffic, vehicle damage and opponents are not simulated.
